senses.gloss:
Gabhasti denotes, according to Roth, the pole of a chariot in the epithet syūma-gabhasti, ‘having reins as a pole,’ used of the car of the gods in the Rigveda, and independently in the plural in the taittirīya brāhmaṇa. The meaning is, however, doubtful. Roth himself suggests that syūma-gabhasti may refer to a sort of double reins.
